product: SurveyMonkey connector is available in Beta
tagline: The managed SurveyMonkey connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta.
what_it_does: The managed SurveyMonkey connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the Previews page. Use the connector to ingest surveys, survey structure, collectors, survey responses, and contacts from SurveyMonkey into Databricks.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
